evidence_table.locator: Statements of operations, p. 5; cost of revenues and gross margin table in Item 2. Three months ended September 30.
evidence_table.evidence: “Services and other” revenue/cost: 2026 4605/3871; 2025 3475/3109. Cross-check combined less automotive gross profit: 4540−3806=734; 3981−3615=366. Increase 368; total increase 5494−5054=440. 368/440=83.64%; 734/5494=13.36%. Automotive +191, energy −119, net +72. Category gross profit precedes operating expenses.

evidence_table.locator: Statements of operations, p. 5 in each, three-month columns.
evidence_table.claim: Gross profit per $100 and sequential bridge
evidence_table.evidence: 3475−3109=366; 4581−3933=648; 4605−3871=734. Gross margin 10.53%, 14.15%, 15.94% respectively. September vs June: $24m more revenue and $62m lower cost = $86m more gross profit.

evidence_table.locator: Item 2, Results of Operations, Services and other revenue discussion, p. 34
